definition: Small towers rising above a building or castle.
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
quote: There were fantastically dressed people under the trees and in the distance there was a glimpse of the turrets of a castle.
example_sentence: The sandcastle had four turrets and a moat full of crisps.
